set.body:
GOAL: the desktop matches the 2026-10-11 design boards. Land every remaining ticket in docs/studio/design/REVIEW.md (8-18, 20-28) and empty the "Open deviations from the 2026-10-11 boards" section of docs/studio/PARITY_CHECKLIST.md, then republish the canvas and sync the plan text.

DONE WHEN
- Every slice mote below is closed with a landed SHA and tree.
- PARITY_CHECKLIST "Open deviations" lists nothing from tickets 8-28 (recorded exemptions such as ticket 28's resting focus may stay as ordinary deviation bullets).
- TokenFilesSuite has no "pending ticket" deviations.
- REVIEW.md marks each ticket Fixed / Closed.
- origin/main passes studioAll, studioStyleCheck, checkBoundaries on JDK 25 with GITHUB_ACTIONS=true.

PER SLICE (AGENTS.md)
1. mote begin <slice> (claim + reserve the files it touches); agent-owned worktree from origin/main + standalone clone (git clone --no-hardlinks; sbt-git cannot read linked worktrees). Never the primary checkout.
2. Write the failing test first where the ticket names one; verify new checks by mutation.
3. Iterate with testOnly + GITHUB_ACTIONS=true -Werror compile (JDK 25: ~/eyes4s-private-validation/2026-10-10/runtime/jdk25, sbt -java-home).
4. Remove the slice's bullet/ticket number from PARITY_CHECKLIST "Open deviations"; mark REVIEW.md ticket Fixed.
5. Merge origin/main once; gate the merged tree: studioAll studioStyleCheck checkBoundaries (+ io StudioAcceptanceSuite when the fixture or text ids change). Record SHA + tree on the mote. FxRunLock is never bypassed.
6. Land by fast-forward with --force-with-lease=main:<expected old SHA>, pushing as canardlapin (credential helper gh-canardlapin). Then mote done.
Slices of at most half a day; batch two small ready slices into one gate when they touch different files.

STOP AND ASK THE OWNER WHEN
- a ticket needs a decision not settled in DESIGN_SPEC §15 or REVIEW.md "Settled";
- a fix would change a science value, the fixture's numbers, or a public eyes4s API;
- origin/main moves in a way that conflicts with a reserved file;
- a push or tracker write is refused by permissions (hand over the exact command).

ORDER: S1 tokens/type/marks -> S2 maps -> CSS sweep S3-S7 (serial, shared CSS) -> scenes S9-S10 -> figures S11-S13 -> Data S14-S16 -> Results S17-S18 -> S8 parity focus -> docs S19. Independent tracks (maps, figures, Data, Results) may run in parallel worktrees once S1 has landed.
set.title: Desktop matches the 2026-10-11 design boards (review tickets 8-28)
